name: Xanthos-Letoon
description: Xanthos was the capital of ancient Lycia, in southwestern Türkiye, and its hillside is still dotted with Lycian tombs that blend local traditions with Greek style. Four kilometres south, the sanctuary of Letoon was one of the region's major religious centres, dedicated to the goddess Leto. Inscriptions found at both sites help scholars read the Lycian language.
